paper: MountainLion: A Multi-Modal LLM-Based Agent System for Interpretable and Adaptive Financial Trading
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock instantiation of MountainLion's multi-agent, dual-track, adaptive-fusion mechanism; not a native crypto forecast replication and not a test of the paper's forecasting or platform claims.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Sections 3.2 and Appendix B, equations 4-7 and 13-14
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Four specialized agents perform technical analysis, market-dynamics analysis, recommendation integration, and semantic reflection before centralized report integration.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Section 3.3, Figure 4, and Appendix C.1-C.3, equations 15-23
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: A rule/LLM path and a classical machine-learning path forecast in parallel, then enter a convex fusion whose weight reflects rolling historical accuracy and directional correctness.
A closed feedback loop monitors rolling performance and reduces the LLM-track weight when its accuracy deteriorates.
The recommendation system integrates multiple information modalities and refines their joint output into an interpretable action.

four_specialized_agents.A1_technical: Equal-rank integration of the technical modality.
four_specialized_agents.A2_market_dynamics: Equal-rank integration of surprise, attention, and market-sensitivity proxies.
four_specialized_agents.A3_trading_recommendation: Equal integration of all four modality reports.
four_specialized_agents.A4_semantic_reflection: Blend the A3 recommendation with the cross-modality median and shrink conviction when modality signs conflict.

dual_track_policy.ml_model: monthly refitted ridge regression on cross-sectional unit ranks and month-demeaned next-month excess returns
dual_track_policy.llm_track_proxy: deterministic A4 semantic-reflection score from the four agent modalities
dual_track_policy.fusion_quality: mean RankIC plus 0.10 times directional-win-rate minus 0.50
dual_track_policy.fusion_rule: alpha times LLM-track rank plus one-minus-alpha times ML-track rank
dual_track_policy.score_refresh: monthly using only outcomes from formation months strictly before the current formation
dual_track_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: frozen value-weighted long-short deciles with the six cost and missing-return paths

preserved_elements: a recommendation agent integrating multiple pathways
a reflection agent that reconciles conflicting partial reports
parallel rule/LLM-like and classical machine-learning forecast tracks
convex fusion with an alpha weight bounded between zero and one
rolling historical performance feedback that updates alpha
directional correctness as part of adaptive track evaluation
approximated_elements: JKP momentum, surprise, quality, value, and risk characteristics replace OHLCV, news, social, regulatory, and on-chain inputs
a deterministic semantic-consensus rule replaces the unavailable LLM prompts and responses
cross-sectional ridge predictions replace the unidentified classical crypto estimator
RankIC and positive-RankIC frequency replace price-level accuracy and token win rate
monthly updates replace the paper's intraday and daily horizons
a stock score and common portfolio adapter replace narrative recommendations and unspecified trading execution
invented_elements: the four exact JKP modality definitions and their signed directions
equal weighting inside modalities and the recommendation agent
the reflection blend and sign-agreement shrinkage rule
the 60-month ridge training window and ridge penalty
the 24-month fusion-history window and 18-month eligibility threshold
the fusion quality formula, temperature, and 0.10/0.90 alpha bounds
the monthly U.S. top-1,000 score-to-portfolio mapping
